description.value: Red Collar Brewing is a craft brewery and distilling operation in downtown Kamloops, running its taproom alongside the in-house Gin Lane Distillery. The space is divided into a main taproom, a dog-friendly fireplace room, and a summer patio with a combined capacity of up to 140 guests. An open BYOF (Bring Your Own Food) policy means cyclists can bring outside food to pair with house-brewed beers and gin cocktails, and growler fills are available for all beers on the menu.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (1 space) at 76m; rack (1 space) at 90m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active craft brewery and distillery taproom at the OSM address with a matching phone number. The /info-1 and front-page content explicitly state 'Order beer for pick up or local delivery' and describe in-store pickup with no minimum, supporting a Takeout value of true. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Website branding consistently uses 'Red Collar Brewing & Distilling Co.' while OSM records the name as 'Red Collar Brewing' — OSM name may be outdated.
Hours shown on the website are inconsistent across multiple pages, suggesting site content is not uniformly maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, established craft brewery and distillery taproom in downtown Kamloops; a natural refreshment stop for touring cyclists with growler fills and pickup orders available.
enrichment_extras.notes: BYOF (Bring Your Own Food) policy explicitly welcomed; cyclists can bring outside food into the taproom. Growler fills (2L and 1L) available for all beers on tap.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Order beer for pick up or local delivery'; online ordering available for in-store pickup with no minimum order required, per /info-1
